name: damage_idle_reaction
about: Non-lethal damage on a live idle Troika human from an attacker it cannot see. The NPC stands 75 cm in front of the player with its back to it; at 3 s the player, standing (not crouched, so no stealth kill), swings a knife into its back (the melee primary; the first try with a .38 at 275 cm missed: a ranged hit is a roll). The NPC carries the Tutorial_Jack stat template (npctemplate_tutorial.txt Max_Health 819; TutorialThug's 20 died to the 40-point back-stab, and invincible 1 is a total refusal, combat-and-damage.md '`invincible` is a total refusal'), so it survives while every damage response below runs. CAI_BaseNPC::OnTakeDamageAlive 0x10265ed0 (combat-and-damage.md 'NPC damage response'; port ElysiumNpcBaseDamage2.cpp walks it): an attacker that is a client (FL_CLIENT) and not seen (slot 363 FInViewCone false) takes the unknown-attacker memory route, records m_vecLastDamageAttackPos, sets m_bCondTookDamage and the light predicate (damage > 0) sets COND_LIGHT_DAMAGE 0x4c. (Step 6 refuses a NULL attacker before any condition: the scalar TakeDamage input with no activator raises no LIGHT_DAMAGE, which is why the attacker here is the player.) LIGHT_DAMAGE is in SCHED_TROIKA_IDLE_DISPOSITION's interrupt list and breaks it; the idle NPC with no enemy goes ALERT, and CAI_BaseNPCTroika::SelectSchedule 0x102af660's state-3 case runs 0x102b8a60 (0) then the took-damage arm 0x102b8c40 (LIGHT or HEAVY damage: clear m_bCondTookDamage, the attack position into m_vSavePosition, answer 0x8a) -> SCHED_TROIKA_SHOT_BY_UNKNOWN (sched_troika_shot_by_unknown.sch: SET_NPC_FLAG DONT_INVESTIGATE, SET_TOLERANCE_DISTANCE 12, TASK_FIND_COVER_FROM_SAVEPOSITION, ...). The NPC lives. Not asserted: whether TASK_FIND_COVER_FROM_SAVEPOSITION finds a position in this room (the port fails it 'Couldn't find cover (0x8)' and the program falls to FAIL 0x43, then ALERT_WAIT and back to idle; SHOT_BY_UNKNOWN sets no fail schedule, so that fall is retail's own if retail's cover search also finds nothing here, and that search was not read for this room).
